products.name: 6-Month Double Axel Club
products.category: Online figure skating training — live off-ice group classes
products.summary: Live online off-ice group program for skaters who already have their double jumps and are working on the Double Axel: two 45-minute classes every Saturday and Sunday with Coach Marta, 48 classes per 6-month term, $299.
products.description: Level 3 of the VSA jump ladder. For skaters who are already proficient in double jumps off-ice and want to make the transition to the Double Axel off-ice, and to prepare for triple jumps. Classes are live and interactive and run from home; the program progresses from technique fundamentals through power, rotational speed and harder drills over six months.

format.location: At home — any space with room to jump and a stable internet connection.
format.accessDelivery: Confirmation email right after payment; session links and instructions within 24 hours.

level.label: Level 3
level.audience: Skaters who have achieved proficiency in double jumps off-ice and want to transition to the Double Axel.
level.notSuitableFor: Skaters who do not yet have consistent double jumps — they should start with the Double Jumps Club (Level 2).

instructors.name: Marta
instructors.title: Coach
instructors.bio: Figure skating coach with international experience as both a skater and a coach. Trained at MKS Axel Toruń in Poland and with Team Mayer-Virtanen in Finland. Holds a degree in Physical Education.

enrollment.note: The club runs every weekend, year-round. Enroll on any day; session links arrive within 24 hours and you join the next weekend's classes.

curriculum.title: Technique development
points: Correct approach and setup for a successful jump
Generating the rotation and height the Double Axel needs
Precise landings for stability and lower injury risk

curriculum.title: Power and explosiveness
points: Bounding drills that mimic the Double Axel's explosive energy
Core strengthening to stabilise the rotation axis

curriculum.title: Rotational speed
points: Off-ice spins for rotational control and speed
Double-revolution drills to build muscle memory

curriculum.title: Progression
points: Starts with basic drills and increases difficulty as technique improves
Moves into more complex drills and introduces the transition to harder double jumps and triple jumps
